name: obsidian-router
description: Slash commands, skills, sub-agents, and hooks for the obsidian-mcp-router multi-vault MCP server. Three layers: (1) wrappers for the router's 14 MCP primitives (discover/read/write/manage/template); (2) a Karpathy-style LLM-wiki workflow (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, wiki-fold, save, autoresearch); (3) Obsidian-specific helpers (canvas, defuddle, obsidian-bases, obsidian-markdown). Hooks (cross-platform Node, opt-in) auto-load the hot.md cache on session start, auto-commit wiki changes, and prompt for hot.md refresh after substantive turns. Pairs with the npm package obsidian-mcp-router which provides the underlying multi-vault MCP server.
